fact: The draft Law on Artificial Intelligence put to public consultation by MINTTICS in September 2025 provides prison terms of 1 to 12 years and fines up to 1.5 billion kwanzas for malicious use of AI, including discriminatory algorithms and harm to the democratic process.
title: Lei sobre Inteligência Artificial prevê multas de até 1.500 milhões Kz e prisão até 12 anos
